BiblicalUsage: When the sky is red at evening the people say fair weather is coming, and when it is red and lowering in the morning they say foul weather is coming, and Jesus turns their own weather-reading against them: they can discern the face of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
TheologicalSignificance: I take His rebuke personally, because I can read a sky and miss what God is doing right in front of me.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
